messages:
Maria Chen: Quick async check — where are we on the console observability items for this sprint? Specifically: dashboard widget ownership, tracing hook rollout, error-analysis view, and the 90-day retention milestone. Need to update the roadmap board by EOD.

Taylor Nguyen: Dashboard widgets: I finished the refactor for the query layer (PR #4321). Waiting on final UX sign-off from Alex, but technically ready to be wired to the new metrics endpoint.

Alex Rivera: Saw the demo, looks good. UX comments posted on the PR. Biggest ask: make the legend behavior consistent with other dashboards (hover + pin). I can take ownership of the legend polish and merge once UX approves.

Sanjay Patel: Tracing hooks: blocked on one infra change — the trace-agent needs an env var to flip the new sampling path (infra change INF-768). I have a draft change but need the infra team to revive the sidecar image build pipeline. Without that, we can’t enable gradual rollout.

Priya Iyer: Retention question: the compliance team wants 90 days for traces but default metrics retention is 30. If we extend traces to 90 we need to estimate cost delta. Taylor, can you run a quick ballpark token/storage estimate for enabling 90d traces vs 30d? Also is there a flag to make per-org retention non-default?

Taylor Nguyen: Yep — I’ll export the sample retention profile from prod (two weekdays of traffic) and run it through the cost model. Expect numbers in ~2 hours. There is a per-org override in the console already but it’s gated behind the entitlement flag (console.feature.retention_overrides). We can expose it once Security signs off.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Two dependency notes: 1) Alex will own legend polish and merge; 2) Sanjay needs infra team to unblock INF-768. Can someone ping infra? @Infra team?

Sanjay Patel: @Infra team pinged in infra channel a minute ago, flagged as P2. If they don’t respond today I’ll escalate to Devin.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: build pipeline INF-768 queued (build-9812). ETA ~45m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9812

Alex Rivera: UX sign-off done. Leaving one minor comment about mobile overflow but that can be follow-up. I’ll merge after Taylor posts the cost numbers and UX comment resolved.

Priya Iyer: Cost numbers would help us pick default retention. If the delta is >15% we should propose making 90d an opt-in for now. Also want to ensure retention change has clear messaging in billing panel.

Taylor Nguyen: Cost dump attached in PR — short summary: enabling 90d traces increases storage cost ~9% on our sample slice, indexing + query CPU adds another ~3%. Total ~12% ballpark. Caveats: sample is biased high for API-heavy customers, could be lower for others.

Maria Chen: Good — 12% is within threshold. Action items for roadmap update: (a) set retention milestone to "ship opt-in 90d traces" for this sprint, (b) Alex owns legend UX/merge, (c) Sanjay owns infra unblock and rollout gating, (d) Taylor to add retention override docs + add cost note in PR, (e) Priya to draft billing messaging. Anyone disagree?

Sanjay Patel: Sounds good. I’ll follow up in infra channel if INF-768 build fails.

Alex Rivera: Agree. I’ll merge as soon as the PR is green.

Priya Iyer: I’ll draft billing copy and post here for review later today.

Maria Chen: Perfect. I’ll update the roadmap board and mark dependencies. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a one-line update here. :thumbsup:
